verses.text: Yahweh says, “You people of Jerusalem [MET], start to sing!
You will need to make your city much larger
Do not be afraid; you will no longer be ashamed.
I, the Commander of the armies of angels, the Holy one of Israel, who rules over the whole earth,
You were like a woman whose husband left her,
I abandoned you people of Jerusalem for a while,
I was very angry with you for a while,
During the time that Noah lived,
Even if the mountains and hills shake and collapse,
You people of Jerusalem [APO],, your enemies acted very violently toward you;
I will cause the towers on the city wall to be made of ◄rubies/valuable red stones►,
I will be the one who will teach you people
Your government will be strong because of acting justly/fairly;
But I am promising you that I will not allow you to be defeated/injured by soldiers using weapons
